sentence: This project tries to find out how an interplay between a pair of factors contributes to insulin resistance and fatty liver disease.
This project uses whole genome sequencing of bacteria to find genetic causes of antimicrobial resistance and to track how drug-resistant bacteria spread.
This project runs a center that offers gene editing, cell biology and clinical data services for research on HIV in the brain.
This project studies how the aging uterus responds to the hormone progesterone and how that affects pregnancy, using mouse models.
This project tries to find out how the parasite Cryptosporidium persists and why it infects particular hosts.
This project uses DNA nanotechnology to control the position of macromolecules so that their structures can be determined.
This project studies ways to lower cancer cases and deaths, including behavioral interventions that prevent cancer or help find it early.
This project builds deep learning software that analyzes pathology images taken with microscopes.
This project uses genetic sequencing to look for markers in tears that could diagnose Sjögren’s Disease more accurately and earlier.
This project uses single-cell and spatial techniques to build a detailed molecular map of heart valve tissue affected by mitral valve prolapse.
This project builds deep-learning software that finds organs and tissues in 3D images and tells healthy tissue from diseased tissue.
This project studies how heme synthesis controls the fitness and function of regulatory T cells in autoimmune diseases.
This project studies cancer genomes with laboratory and computational methods to help improve cancer outcomes.
This project tests a nebulizer and computer-assisted design to deliver mRNA in tiny particles to lung cells for treating cystic fibrosis.
This project tests genes and proteins as possible drug targets for subtypes of Alzheimer’s disease, using human brains and brain cell models.
This project tests whether low-intensity pulsed ultrasound can repair communication between neurons and astrocytes and improve cognition in Alzheimer’s disease.
This project builds a mindfulness-based smartphone intervention that helps cancer survivors quit smoking when the risk of relapse is high.
This project studies how a frontal brain circuit that projects to the thalamus develops and how social experience or genetic risk changes it.
This project studies where chromatin factors bind to enhancers, which genes they control and how they work.
This project uses a model of Apert syndrome to find out why patients have abnormal eye muscles and tests gene therapy for eye misalignment.
